  html_document:
    theme:
      version: 5

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source(here::here("code", "cooperative_nursery_report.R"))
report <- nursery_sections()
```

```{r intro, results = "asis"}
cat(sprintf(
  paste0("Trials recorded on [T3/Wheat](%s) for each cooperative nursery in the ",
         "registry, drawn from %s trials in total. Each nursery lists every year ",
         "from its first trial to its most recent; a year with no trial is named ",
         "on its own.\n"),
  T3_WHEAT_BASE, format(report$n_trials, big.mark = ",")
))
```

```{r sections, results = "asis"}
for (s in report$sections) {
  cat("\n## ", s$heading, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("::: {.years}\n")
  cat(s$lines, sep = "\n")
  cat("\n:::\n")
}
```

## Nurseries without matching trials

```{r unmatched, results = "asis"}
if (length(report$unmatched) == 0) {
  cat("Every nursery flagged on T3/Wheat had trials carrying its acronym.\n")
} else {
  cat("No T3/Wheat trial name contains these acronyms, so they have no section",
      "above:\n\n")
  cat(paste0("- `", report$unmatched, "`"), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n")
}
```
